stage0006_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0006_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Welcome aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.
　I'm her captain, Colonel $$オットー・ミタス$$.」

stage0006_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$,
　captain of the Macross Quarter.
　This is Major $$オズマ・リー$$, our strike leader.」

stage0006_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$オットー$$
「Now, let me introduce my staff as well.
　This is my XO, Lt. Colonel $$レイアム・ボーリンネア$$...」

stage0006_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$オットー$$
「And this is Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ・マックール$$ of
　Echoes, with his aide, Major $$コンロイ・ハーゲンセン$$.」

stage0006_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$オズマ$$
（So that's Echoes, the so-called Manhunters...）

stage0006_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「A pleasure, Colonel $$ジェフリー$$.
　I've heard rumors of the Frontier fleet's
　$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ myself.」

stage0006_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And I've heard of Echoes' exploits as well.
　With you both aboard, I can guess this ship's
　mission well enough.」

stage0006_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Manhunters...
　So you knew our main duty as well...」

stage0006_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then this will be quick.
　As you guessed, Londo Bell's main duty lately
　is investigating Neo Zeon's ominous movements.」

stage0006_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Under Commander $$ブライト・ノア$$'s orders,
　each ship operates on Earth or in space.」

stage0006_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So you're here to investigate their
　activity within the atmosphere?」

stage0006_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「That's right.
　We're pursuing a suspected Neo Zeon mobile
　suit unit that descended to Earth recently.」

stage0006_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$甲児$$
「...So I get what Londo Bell's job is, but
　isn't Neo Zeon a political group pushing
　for colony rights?」

stage0006_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$甲児$$
「Earth and the colonies are one Federation
　now, right? So Neo Zeon's forces should be
　part of the Federation military too.」

stage0006_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Technically, that's how it stands.」

stage0006_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$甲児$$ and $$アルト$$ are from 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》, so
　you probably don't really understand
　what Zeon is...」

stage0006_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Where I'm from, in 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》,
　that name carries special weight.」

stage0006_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「About 10 years ago, Zeon was one of the
　worlds making up 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》, and it started a
　war of independence from the Federation.」

stage0006_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ever since, its name has stood for the
　grievances and anger of Spacenoids...
　people who live in space.」

stage0006_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アルト$$
「But didn't Zeon lose to the Federation?」

stage0006_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's right.
　But part of its forces escaped the Earth
　Sphere, waiting for a chance to rise again.」

stage0006_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And plenty of people were unhappy with
　the Federation's later Spacenoid policy too.」

stage0006_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So Zeon's influence never really faded,
　even after the $$大時空震動$$.」

stage0006_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ファ$$
「In 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》, during the 《$$多元戦争$$》,
　Zeon's remnant 《$$アクシズ$$》 joined hands
　with 《$$プラント$$》 to fight the Federation.」

stage0006_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「After that fight... while we were thrown
　into $$ＡＤＷ$$, Zeon changed its name to Neo Zeon
　and came back into the spotlight in $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

stage0006_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$さやか$$
「But after the $$新世時空震動$$ merged $$ＵＣＷ$$
　and $$ＡＤＷ$$, didn't Neo Zeon and $$プラント$$ join
　the Federation like the other colony states?」

stage0006_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Plenty of people see that as
　only temporary.」

stage0006_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「In fact, even in this new world,
　some Spacenoids have already started
　resenting Federation policy.」

stage0006_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Yeah.
　Even in the Federation's parliament, Neo
　Zeon and $$プラント$$ act like the opposition.」

stage0006_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Neo Zeon's leader is that woman,
　$$ハマーン・カーン$$, right?」

stage0006_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I've seen her on TV too.
　Quite the beauty, but she looks tough.」

stage0006_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ミシェル$$'s right, she's a strong person.
　As a pilot, and as a political leader too...」

stage0006_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「And at the same time, it's true the
　Federation tends to look down on Spacenoids.」

stage0006_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Against that faction,
　$$ハマーン$$ will never back down.」

stage0006_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Still, 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》 had a tendency to look down
　on Spacenoids too, but I didn't know
　《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 was the same...」

stage0006_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Inside $$ＵＣＷ$$'s Federation,
　factions like 《$$ティターンズ$$》 and 《$$ブルーコスモス$$》
　held a lot of power.」

stage0006_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I thought groups like that were wiped out
　in the $$多元戦争$$, but they run deeper.」

stage0006_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$さやか$$
「Will the Federation and Neo Zeon go to war...?」

stage0006_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Their conflict is growing, sure, but
　without some major trigger, I don't think
　it'll come to war.」

stage0006_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Besides, not every Spacenoid supports
　$$ハマーン$$'s hardline stance
　either.」

stage0006_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「But I hear some people are trying to
　set up someone from the Zabi family,
　old Zeon's leaders, as a figurehead.」

stage0006_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アルト$$
「Bloodline politics, in this day and age?」

stage0006_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It might sound like nonsense, but an
　organization needs some kind of symbol
　to move people.」

stage0006_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$甲児$$
「In that sense, this $$ハマーン$$ person...
　seems a bit scary, not the type to
　rally everyone as a unifying leader.」

stage0006_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Then that's a relief.
　That Zabi is a girl named $$ミネバ$$ Zabi, right?」

stage0006_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Saw it on the news...
　apparently she's not even 10 yet.」

stage0006_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Oh, right, haven't introduced them.
　This is $F.
　Also our classmate.」

stage0006_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$.
　I fought alongside $$甲児$$ in the Regeneration
　War, but now I'm an Anaheim test pilot.」

stage0006_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$ファ・ユイリィ$$.
　I'm $$カミーユ$$'s assistant at Anaheim.」

stage0006_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$n
「Thanks for the help in the last battle.」

stage0006_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you're the pilot of that blue machine...」

stage0006_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Seems like the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will be
　operating alongside the Quarter for
　a while. Good to meet you properly.」

stage0006_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$カミーユ$$...
　What happened to your $$Ｚガンダム$$?」

stage0006_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Zeta's under overhaul at Anaheim on
　the Moon. Checking every part takes a while.」

stage0006_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guys like the ones from back then
　showed up again... Hope it's back soon.」

stage0006_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But this maintenance on the Zeta was
　awfully sudden. Unnaturally so...）

stage0006_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So, $n...
　what did you mean, 'can't be optimistic'?」

stage0006_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$n
「Some underground sites are saying the
　public $$ミネバ$$ Zabi is a body double, and
　the real one is much older.」

stage0006_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ファ$$
「Why use a younger stand-in at all?」

stage0006_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$n
「Probably to throw off the Federation's guard.」

stage0006_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see.
　So looking like a kid lulls the Federation.」

stage0006_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Given the odd feeling I had meeting $$ミネバ$$
　in the $$多元戦争$$, that's not baseless...）

stage0006_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But... what is this unease...
　Am I afraid of $$ハマーン$$'s pressure...?）

stage0006_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, once your touching reunion's
　settled down, mind introducing us too?」

stage0006_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$リディ$$
「Then let me introduce myself to you kids.
　I'm Ensign $$リディ・マーセナス$$, and aboard
　this ship I fly $$リゼル$$ Unit 2.」

stage0006_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's a sore spot to poke at...
　$$カミーユ$$ flies Unit 1.」

stage0006_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$リディ$$
「Trailing behind a civilian is pretty
　sad, but sadly, right now $$カミーユ$$'s just
　the better pilot.」

stage0006_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$リディ$$
「No, no, I'm formally throwing down
　a challenge to you here.
　You'll accept, won't you, $$カミーユ$$?」

stage0006_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that's what you want, Ensign.」

stage0006_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$リディ$$
「Good, it's settled.
　...You all can be witnesses.
　I'll take the ace spot from $$カミーユ$$ myself.」

stage0006_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$甲児$$
「He's pretty easygoing
　for a military man.」

stage0006_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アルト$$
「I figured a Federation elite would be
　some stiff, but I think we'll get
　along fine with this guy.」

stage0006_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$エマ$$
「This $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is mostly
　an experimental deployment, so it
　might be a bit of a special case.」

stage0006_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$エマ$$
「I'm Lieutenant $$エマ・シーン$$.
　I've heard about you from $$カミーユ$$ and $$ファ$$.」

stage0006_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$カツ$$
「I'm $$カツ・コバヤシ$$.
　Like $$カミーユ$$ and $$ファ$$, I'm a test
　pilot at Anaheim.」

stage0006_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ファ$$
「Lieutenant $$エマ$$ and $$カツ$$ fought
　alongside me and $$カミーユ$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$.」

stage0006_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アルト$$
「So they're members of that 《$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$》 outfit.」

stage0006_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sounds like we can count on them.」

stage0006_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$リディ$$
「Hey now, I wasn't part of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$,
　but you can count on me too.」

stage0006_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「By the way, Lieutenant $$エマ$$...
　what did you mean by 'experimental deployment'?」

stage0006_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$エマ$$
「The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is the successor to
　a ship called the Argama, originally
　used by $$エゥーゴ$$.」

stage0006_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アルト$$
「《$$エゥーゴ$$》...
　The group $$カミーユ$$ and the others were in.」

stage0006_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$エマ$$
「With the mess of $$エゥーゴ$$ folding into the
　Federation, this ship has no sister ships.」

stage0006_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$エマ$$
「So we naturally end up on solo missions,
　operating apart from Londo Bell's main force.」

stage0006_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So Ensign $$リディ$$ and I were running
　evaluation tests on the new $$リゼル$$...」

stage0006_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We chased a Neo Zeon unit that dropped
　into the atmosphere, and ended up in real combat.」

stage0006_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is that $$リゼル$$ a mass-production
　version of your $$Ｚガンダム$$?」

stage0006_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It carries on the concept, but
　structurally it's more a $$メタス$$ derivative.」

stage0006_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ファ$$
「That's why I'm in on the testing too.」

stage0006_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$甲児$$
「So us meeting again like this
　was pretty much a coincidence, huh.」

stage0006_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「If we get time, I'll show you around
　$$第２新東京市$$. $$沙慈$$'s at the Anaheim
　technical school too.」

stage0006_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He's here in Japan too, huh.」

stage0006_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$リディ$$
「It's a nice thing,
　reuniting with old friends.」

stage0006_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$エマ$$
「Ensign... this might be overstepping, but
　why not visit your family while you're on Earth?」

stage0006_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$エマ$$
「Still can't bring yourself to go?」

stage0006_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$リディ$$
「...Not until the day I can be proud I've
　made it on my own, with no help from my
　family name...」

stage0006_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's exactly why I want to beat $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0006_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$エマ$$
「I understand.
　But don't let yourself rush.」

stage0006_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「All pilots, report to the briefing room.」

stage0006_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カツ$$
「Did something happen, Major $$コンロイ$$?」

stage0006_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「The recon team just reported spotting a unit
　that looks like it belongs to the force
　we've been tracking.」

stage0006_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「We're moving out to confirm it.
　Quarter's crew, I need your help too.」

stage0006_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$甲児$$
「If there's someone trying to start another war,
　we'll be the ones to take them on.」

stage0006_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$リディ$$
「...That unit we fought today...
　is it really Neo Zeon's, after all...?」

stage0006_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カツ$$
「Does $$ハマーン$$ intend to go to war with the Federation?
　If so, I can't forgive that.」

stage0006_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$カツ$$
「After the $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ finally joined hands
　to build the Earth Federation...!」

stage0006_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But it's not as if the Earth Federation
　is without problems of its own.」

stage0006_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The deep-rooted contempt for Spacenoids,
　left unchecked, will breed a bigger war someday.」

stage0006_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$カツ$$
「So are you saying, $$カミーユ$$, that a war
　happening just can't be helped...!?」

stage0006_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's not what I meant.」

stage0006_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why, like Captain $$ジェフリー$$ said,
　the Federation's response to today matters most.」

stage0006_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ファ$$
「They won't use this as an excuse
　to suddenly crack down on Spacenoids... right?」

stage0006_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$エマ$$
「Do that, and it'll only stir up backlash...
　that's exactly what would start a war.」

stage0006_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$エマ$$
「Besides, the moderates within the Federation
　would never let a few reckless people run wild.」

stage0006_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Maybe Neo Zeon moved that unit
　from the start just to gauge
　how the Federation would respond...）

stage0006_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（But would $$ハマーン$$ really
　take such a cautious approach...?
　If so, then behind it there's...）

stage0006_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カツ$$
「I'll say it straight, $$カミーユ$$.
　Part of you is still thinking about Captain $$クワトロ$$.」

stage0006_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$カツ$$
「What you fear most right now
　is that Captain $$クワトロ$$ became Neo Zeon's leader
　and is the one giving the orders for this fight.」

stage0006_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$リディ$$
「Wait a second.
　Wasn't Captain $$クワトロ$$ the leader of the $$エゥーゴ$$?
　How did he end up with Neo Zeon...?」

stage0006_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That man is $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　also known as Zeon's Red Comet.」

stage0006_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$甲児$$
「Who is that?
　This $$シャア・アズナブル$$ guy.」

stage0006_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$エマ$$
「It probably means nothing to you
　$$ＡＤＷ$$ folks, but he was a Zeon ace pilot.」

stage0006_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$エマ$$
「Not just an excellent pilot...
　they say his charisma made him more
　than just another officer.」

stage0006_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$シャア$$ was $$アムロ$$'s rival, and they clashed
　again and again in the war between Zeon
　and the Federation, the so-called $$一年戦争$$.」

stage0006_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$甲児$$
「But didn't Captain $$クワトロ$$ fight
　the $$多元戦争$$ alongside $$カミーユ$$
　and Captain $$アムロ$$ in the $$エゥーゴ$$?」

stage0006_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He thought about what mattered most
　to the world, and fought alongside us.」

stage0006_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That held true even after he was flung to the $$ＡＤＷ$$
　and fought as part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

stage0006_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So I don't want to believe
　that Captain $$クワトロ$$ went back to Neo Zeon
　and is trying to start this fight.」

stage0006_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$リディ$$
「No use fretting over what hasn't happened.
　You just give your all to what's in front of you.」

stage0006_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$リディ$$
「Because that's how I want to live.」

stage0006_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$リディ$$
「If you're grateful, help me sort today's combat data.
　The unit at the head of that $$ギラ・ドーガ$$ squad
　seems to be built for an Enhanced Human.」

stage0006_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes.
　I'll help, if you'll have me.」

stage0006_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Do your best, $$カミーユ$$.
　We're heading back.」

stage0006_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アルト$$
「No, to $$第２新東京市$$.
　We've got to prep for next week's school trip.」

stage0006_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come to think of it, you're all still students too.」

stage0006_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're not Federation military either...
　why not come to Jindai High?」

stage0006_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「No... I'm a test pilot because I want to be.
　Right now, I want to give this my all.」

stage0006_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$甲児$$
「You and $n are both so serious.
　Don't push yourselves too hard.」

stage0006_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Captain $$クワトロ$$...
　I believe someone who fought 《$$トレーズ$$》 Khushrenada
　wouldn't do anything foolish.）

stage0006_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（So I won't dwell on it...
　I'll keep moving forward in my own way.）

stage0006_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$カイザス$$
「...It seems the unit that descended to Earth
　accomplished its objective safely.」

stage0006_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$...
　more useful than I expected.」

stage0006_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Now then, will this make the Earth Federation's
　intentions clear, I wonder...」

stage0006_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Who knows.
　...Can we really afford to keep taking
　such half-hearted measures?」

stage0006_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$カイザス$$
「But this is what that man, the Colonel, wants.」

stage0006_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$カイザス$$
「His very existence could be Neo Zeon's figurehead.」

stage0006_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Which one the times call for...
　you must already know, Your Excellency.」

stage0006_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「He's fit to serve as a placeholder, at least...」

stage0006_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$カイザス$$
「All because that man vanished from the $$ＵＣＷ$$,
　if only for about half a year.」

stage0006_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$カイザス$$
「For my part, I hope he makes up his mind too.」

stage0006_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... we're both still hung up on him.」

stage0006_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カイザス$$
「It's not just you and me, Your Excellency.
　His existence is special
　to every Spacenoid.」

stage0006_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$カイザス$$
「That's why the Colonel is needed for the age to come.」

stage0006_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I understand that much myself.
　That's why I take the front and shoulder the chores.」

stage0006_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カイザス$$
「I can only imagine the strain on you.」

stage0006_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Now we just wait and see how the Federation moves.
　Depending on that, things could get busy.」

stage0006_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Then I'll begin preparing for talks with $$プラント$$.」

stage0006_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（$$シャア$$...
　the world keeps turning, even without you...）

stage0006_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（In this world, I'll fulfill Zeon's cherished wish.
　By my own hand...）

stage0006_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, well, well, Master $$カミーユ$$...
　that sortie must have been quite something.」

stage0006_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$...
　$$ルカ$$ told me about you, but you're really something.」

stage0006_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, not at all... I'm just
　a stingy little Z-Chip miser myself.」

stage0006_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, that pilot $$ギュネイ$$'s rivalry with
　you, Master $$カミーユ$$, it made for fine Z-Chips.」

stage0006_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Worth a whopping 100Z!
　I'll add this straight to the stock.」

stage0006_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So that's how Z-Chips get made...」

stage0006_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But please be careful.
　That man... he'll surely come after you
　again, Master $$カミーユ$$, given the chance.」

stage0006_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Thanks.
　But I don't plan on going down easily either.」

stage0006_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the spirit.
　I'll look forward to more lovely Z-Chips.」

stage0006_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If Earth and space end up split clean in two
　and go to war like this, I wonder what'll happen...」

stage0006_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Turbulent times are good for business,
　but sadly, all I can do right now
　is run the D-Trader...」

stage0006_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, I wish HQ would send a pickup soon...
　or I might just go and wildly modify the $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0006_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding, joking aside...
　let's get fired up today too... business, business!」
